entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: MR HARSH M SURTI(3907) for the Applicant(s) No. 1  MR CHINTAN H. DAVE, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1

Learned advocate Ms. Punita Joshi for learned advocate Mr. Harsh M. Surti appearing for the applicants submits that, in the factual circumstances that the trial has already commenced and matter is at the stage of evidence of the prosecution as it is discerned from the report of the learned trial Court, she seeks permission to withdraw both the applications with a relief to expedite the trial before the learned trial Court.

2. In view of above, permission as prayed for is granted, both the Criminal Misc. Applications stand disposed of as withdrawn, with the direction that the learned trial Court shall endeavour to complete the trial within 01 year from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.
